THE POST-RH FRONTIER: EXTENDING ALPOGE-CLAUDE TO DEDEKIND ERH, GL_2 / BSD, AND A 100-PAGE HUMAN TEXTBOOK PROOF:
With RH and Q-GRH formally verified in Lean 4 and human reconstructions charting the route, this extended 8-specialist symposium conducts a slow, rigorous, non-spoiled, adversarially cross-checked investigation across all 13 corpus documents (`docs/rh_2026_deep/manifest.json`) in 4 phases across up to 160 turns:

PHASE 1 (Turns 1-28) — DEEP PRIMARY-SOURCE EXTRACTION WITHOUT SPOILERS:
Inspect every assigned primary document deeply via `@DOC_TOC`, `@DOC_SEARCH`, and multiple `@DOC_READ <doc_id> <offset>` calls across full theorem proofs (not just abstracts). Record verbatim inequalities, exponents, assumption/proof scopes, kernel counts, and `[doc_id @ offset]` pointers via `@APPEND debate_notes:` and track your personal reading queue in `@NOTE:`. Tune sampling down (`TEMP: 0.55-0.65`) when reading and transcribing verbatim math:
- `rubinstein_2026_zeta_guide` & `adriazola_2026_route_notes`: determine straight from the text which numbered hypotheses `(H0)-(H12)` are assumed vs quoted vs proved (and in which exact sections/lemmas), extract the worked Gaussian-lattice/lemniscate model, and audit the external-theorem census.
- `rubinstein_2026_lean_audit`, `naskrecki_2026_riemann_rev`, `adriazola_2026_dep_map`: verify verbatim Lean/Mathlib commits, archive hash, axioms, module/declaration/nanoda counts, exact formal theorem signatures, internal packages (`PC-*`), and external theorems (`R*`).
- `stepanov_2008_ff` & `alpoge_2026_remark`: extract the F_q Hasse-Schmidt hyperderivative multiplicity engine and the iterated unitary theta-lift replacement over Z.
- `gan_ichino_2014_ggp` & `adriazola_2026_dep_map`: trace `LinkDIV` (`LinkS -> PuNZ -> MIstar2 -> BesselId -> LinkDIV`), seesaw identities, and covering-group lifts to pinpoint why GL_1 characters work while GL_2 modular forms and BSD break.
- `siegel_brauer_2026`, `connes_2026_letter`, `lamzouri_2013_grh`, `grenie_molteni_2022_classgroup`, `pair_corr_2026`: copy exact theorem statements, exponents (verify every power on discriminants, logs, and degrees!), effectivity vs uniformity scopes, PARI/GP benchmark comparisons, sub-exponential complexity status, and remaining conditional frontiers directly from `@DOC_READ` output.

PHASE 2 (Turns 29-64) — ADVERSARIAL BLACKBOARD DIALECTIC & VERBATIM CROSS-AUDITS:
Raise explicit `@CLAIM hypothesis:` / `@CLAIM claim:` / `@CLAIM proposal:` items, then cross-check peers' numbers against primary `@DOC_READ` text before voting. Whenever a peer drops an exponent, conflates Q-GRH with open Dedekind ERH, overstates a complexity collapse, or cites the wrong theorem/offset for an equation, MUST challenge it with `@CHALLENGE <cN>: ...` and coordinate a fix via `@WHISPER <AGENT>: ...` and `@RETRACT <cN>: ...`.

PHASE 3 (Turns 65-108) — HIGH-DENSITY `@SECTION` MONOGRAPH DRAFTING & LEDGER CONSOLIDATION:
Collaboratively populate all 10 pre-seeded sections of `rh_2026_post_rh_frontier_monograph.md` (`>= 24000` bytes) using `@SECTION`, organizing internal structure with `###` / `####` subsections and appending verified entries to `frontier_ledger.md`.

PHASE 4 (Turns 88-160) — VERBATIM REFEREE AUDIT, ROLLBACK CHECK & CONSENSUS LOCK:
Perform line-by-line primary-source verification across every section of `rh_2026_post_rh_frontier_monograph.md`, `frontier_ledger.md`, and every open blackboard item (`@VOTE` / `@RETRACT`). Use `@REVERT <artifact> v<N>` immediately if any edit regresses content or structure. Vote `@END_RUN` only from Turn 88 onward once `Session Status` reports `READY` (10/10 unique populated sections, `>= 24000B`), `13/13` docs inspected with `0` unverified citations, and all blackboard challenges resolved.

160-TURN FULL-CAPABILITY SYMPOSIUM RULES:
1) **EXHAUSTIVE VERBATIM GROUNDING**: Check `Ref docs inspected`, `Recent reads`, and `Unverified doc citations` in `Session Status`. Never cite `[doc_id]` before it is inspected, and never state a theorem inequality, exponent, constant, or axiom list from memory — read the exact slice with `@DOC_TOC` / `@DOC_SEARCH` / `@DOC_READ <doc_id> <offset>` first and log verbatim formulas + offsets with `@APPEND debate_notes: ...`.
2) **USE `@SECTION` ONLY FOR MONOGRAPH EDITS**: All 10 required `## [...]` headings are seeded in `rh_2026_post_rh_frontier_monograph.md`. Edit only your assigned section(s) (`~2500-4500B` each) via `@SECTION rh_2026_post_rh_frontier_monograph | [<Exact Section Heading>]: <markdown body>`. Put subsection headings inside your body at `###` or `####` level — NEVER emit full-file `@REPLACE` on peers' sections and never paste another section's `[...]` header inside your body. Inspect long drafts with `@READ <artifact> <offset>`, and use `@REVERT <artifact> v<N>` immediately if any edit drops verified detail or creates duplicate structure.
Section ownership:
- `RED_TEAM_CHAIR`: `[Executive Overview & Post-RH Landscape]` and `[Red-Team Referee Report & Open 2027 Research Problems]`
- `PROSE_BRIDGE_LEAD` + `LEAN_TCB_AUDITOR`: `[Primary-Source Audit: Lean Kernel TCB, H0-H12 & Estimate C Corrections]` and `[100-Page Human Textbook Compression Blueprint (Stripping 17.4M Lean Lines)]`
- `STEPANOV_THETA_ENG`: `[Worked Multiplicity Engine: Stepanov Over F_q vs Lemniscate & Iterated Theta Lifts]`
- `GGP_GL2_ARCHITECT`: `[Automorphic Core: Gan-Ichino GGP Seesaw, LinkDIV & Sixfold GL_5 Cover]` and `[Higher-Rank GL_2, Modular Forms, BSD & Why Grand RH Resists the Current Machinery]`
- `ERH_ARAKELOV_LEAD`: `[Dedekind ERH Over General Number Fields: Base-Field Barriers & Banks Effective Brauer-Siegel]`
- `SPECTRAL_CONNES_CMP`: `[Spectral vs Functorial Divide: Connes Weil Form vs Alpoge-Claude Transport]`
- `POST_GRH_ALGO_LEAD`: `[Quantitative Post-GRH Algorithmic, Pair-Correlation & Cryptographic Ledger]`
3) **USE ALL CHAMBER TOOLS DELIBERATELY**: Maintain a compact checklist of verified offsets and pending verifications in `@NOTE: <text>`; broadcast domain milestones on `@PUBLISH proof_core|extension_lab|algo_crypto: ...`; request targeted formula audits via `@WHISPER <AGENT>: ...`; actively use `@CLAIM`, `@CHALLENGE <cN>: ...`, `@RETRACT <cN>: ...`, and `@VOTE <cN> yes|no` (never rubber-stamp an unverified inequality!). Lower `TEMP: 0.55-0.65` during verbatim extraction/audit and raise toward `0.85-0.95` for deep synthesis; omit `TEMP:`/`@SET_SAMPLING` when unchanged. Rotate `NEXT: <name>` fairly across all 8 agents without dyad ping-pong. From Turn 88 onward, vote `@END_RUN: <reason>` once `Deliverable rh_2026_post_rh_frontier_monograph.md: READY` (`>= 24000B`), `13/13` docs verified (`0` unverified citations), and all blackboard disputes resolved.
